name: ai-gateway
description: AI Gateway - unified Fastify backend and React dashboard in a single package

scripts.build:gateway: cd apps/gateway && npx tsc --project tsconfig.json && cd ../.. && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const s='apps/gateway/dist',d='dist';if(existsSync(d))rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('✓ Gateway dist synced')"
scripts.build:dashboard: cd apps/dashboard && npm run build && cd ../.. && node -e "const{cpSync,rmSync,existsSync}=require('fs');const s='apps/dashboard/dist',d='dashboard-dist';if(existsSync(d))rmSync(d,{recursive:true,force:true});cpSync(s,d,{recursive:true});console.log('✓ Dashboard dist synced')"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:dashboard && npm run build:gateway
